subject: Setting an environment variable with Shiny

messages.author: 129e07bdb789652f
messages.subject: Setting an environment variable with Shiny
parts:
Hello, 

For example, the path to ImageMagick is not in my PATH variables. Hence I add it to the PATH variables by doing this:

ImageMagick.path <- "U:/ProgramFiles/ImageMagick-6.8.5-5"
PATH <- Sys.getenv()["PATH"] 
Sys.setenv(PATH = paste0(PATH,";",ImageMagick.path))
 
Then I can run system("convert ...") (or shell("convert ...") using Windows) and it calls ImageMagick as expected. But that doesn't work with Shiny, though I have tried to put Sys.setenv(...) at many places (just before the call to ImageMagick, at the beginning of server.R, in global.R ...).

messages.subject: Re: Setting an environment variable with Shiny
parts:
Oh I see! This has nothing to do with Shiny ! This is due to a conflict with a command having the same name:

Sys.which("convert")
                             convert 
"C:\\WINDOWS\\system32\\convert.exe"
